relevance_note: The paper describes a family with three HA20 patients carrying TNFAIP3 c.707T>C, p.(Leu236Pro) ('identified in three patients from the same family'), plus a Table 2 summarising index cases of 12 previously reported TNFAIP3 missense variants.
method_note: Read the full Markdown, including the supplementary material (raw western blot and flow-cytometry exports only; no clinical or individual-level content). A Python script in my scratch directory pulled Table 1 and Table 2 cells by column and assembled the JSON from values I chose by reading; I checked the parsed cells against both tables. Table 1 has patients as columns, headers 'I.1', 'II.1', 'II.2'. Table 2 also has patients as columns: each column is the index case for one missense variant, headed by the variant string (row 'Molecular TNFAIP3 (NM_006290) anomaly'). Label rule 3 speaks of table rows; because Table 2 is transposed, its people are labelled 'Table 2 column k', with k counting data columns from the left: 1 = c.707T>C, p.(Leu236Pro) (current study; this is proband II.2, recorded under 'II.2'), 2 = c.305A>G (Chen), 3 = c.386C>T (Aslani), 4 = c.574G>A (Kadowaki), 5 = c.728G>A (Shigemura), 6 = c.824T>C (Aslani), 7 = c.929T>C (Kadowaki), 8 = c.1129G>A (Niwano), 9 = c.1428G>A (Dong), 10 = c.1639G>A (Tian), 11 = c.1804A>T (Jiang), 12 = c.1939A>C (Mulhern), 13 = c.2126A>G (Kadowaki). Relatives named in Table 2's 'Family segregation' cells get rows ('father of Table 2 column 2', etc.); 'three other family members' (column 5) are numbered with ' 2', ' 3'. The 'sisters' of column 10 get no rows because their number is not stated; the mother does get one. Relatives in column 8 had 'no genetic analysis', so they have no variant rows. For long Table 2 rows, a span is the cell text alone, or the cell with its left neighbour, instead of row label through cell. 'No' cells in Tables 1 and 2 are read as explicit absence: a word, not an undefined symbol. Broader absences map to the checklist: 'Musculoskeletal: No' excludes arthritis or arthralgia; 'Ocular: No' excludes uveitis; 'Hepatic: No' excludes autoimmune hepatitis; 'Ulcers: No' excludes oral and genital ulcers but not the composite GI item. 'Cardiovascular: No' was not used to exclude 'pericarditis or other serositis' or 'vasculitis'. 'No symptoms' (columns 7 and 13) is recorded as a feature row but excludes no checklist item. The vague statements 'same symptoms', 'milder symptoms' and '(mildly) symptomatic' are recorded as observed feature rows only. Not recorded: Table 1 CRP values (15, 7, 7 mg/L), because no reference range or 'elevated' statement is given; the elevated plasma cytokines, because they are reported only as a group comparison; I.2's 'healthy', which names no feature; the two IL6-antagonist-treated patients (Lawless et al., 2018; Zhou et al., 2016), mentioned only at group level; the cerebral hemorrhage of column 3, which is recorded as a feature but not as checklist CNS involvement. Inheritance is 'not reported' for II.1 and II.2: the father carries the variant and the mother tested negative, but the paper does not state the origin. It is also 'not reported' for column 6, called 'de novo variation' with no parental testing described. Zygosity is 'not reported' for literature cases. Consanguinity is stated only for II.2. Contradictions: (1) p.(Leu236Pro) is 'of uncertain significance' per ACMG in Results, but 'Likely pathogenic' per ACMG in Table 2 and pathogenic in the text. (2) The p.(Asn102Ser) reference is 'Chen et al., 2020b' in Table 2 but 'Chen et al., 2020a' in the text and table notes; 2020b in the reference list is the PremPS methods paper. (3) p.(Leu275Pro) is 'Pathogenic' in Table 2 but 'likely pathogenic' in the text. (4) p.(Thr602Ser) is 'Likely pathogenic' in Table 2 but 'can be considered as pathogenic' in the text. (5) The text says p.(Thr647Pro) carriers 'lack HA20 hallmark clinical features', yet Table 2 lists occasional oral ulcers for the index case and '(mildly) symptomatic' carriers. (6) Table 2 footnote markers are inconsistent: cells use ^* and ^&, the footer defines ^$ and ^§, and ^& is undefined. (7) Colchicine response for II.2 is 'significant improvement' in the text but 'partial response' in Table 2.
